min-height.$description: Tap-target floor for the small button; falls between Sizing md (32) and ml (48).

font-size.$description: Compact tag label, below the smallest Body step (13), so it sits outside the type scale.

xs.$description: Status dot diameter, below the smallest Sizing step (xxs = 12).

letter-spacing.$description: Relative (em) tracking has no global ancestor; the scales are in px.

outline-width.$description: Focus ring stroke width; the system has no border-width scale.

outline-offset.$description: Focus ring gap, measured against the ring itself rather than the spacing scale.
